# Al-Irshaad Islamic Institute (معھد الإرشاد الإسلامي)

> Al-Irshaad Islamic Institute is a premier online Islamic educational platform providing authentic 1-on-1 and small group Qur'an recitation, applied Tajweed, 3-cycle Hifdh memorization, comprehensive Islamic studies, and Arabic language instruction for children, teens, and adults in Nigeria and across the global diaspora (UK, US, Canada, Europe, Middle East).

## Key Information
- **Name**: Al-Irshaad Islamic Institute (معھد الإرشاد الإسلامي)
- **Primary Website**: https://al-irshaad-islamic-institute.vercel.app/
- **Admissions & WhatsApp**: +234 808 381 8671
- **Email**: alirshaadislamicinstitute@gmail.com
- **Core Format**: Live 1-on-1 and small group online sessions via Zoom/Google Meet with certified Huffaz and Islamic scholars.
- **Target Audience**: Muslim children (ages 4+), teenagers, university students, working professionals, adult learners, and diaspora families.
- **Supported Timezones**: All global timezones (GMT, WAT, EST, CST, PST, BST, GST).

## Educational Pathways & Programs
1. **Nuurul Bayaan (Beginners 4+)** (`/programs/nuurul-bayaan`):
   - Foundation in Arabic phonetics, letter recognition, articulation points (Makharij), and early word synthesis.
2. **Qur'an Recitation with Applied Tajweed** (`/programs/quran-recitation`):
   - Systematic verse-by-verse recitation fluency, Noon Saakinah, Meem Saakinah, Mudood (prolongations), Waqf (stopping rules).
3. **Qur'an Memorization (Hifdh Program)** (`/programs/hifdh`):
   - Structured 3-Cycle systematic retention methodology (New Lesson, Recent Revision, Far Revision) with certified Haafidh mentors.
4. **Fundamentals of Islamic Studies** (`/programs/islamic-studies`):
   - 3 Age-appropriate tracks:
     - Level 1: Foundations (Ages 5–10) - Pillars of Islam & Iman, basic Fiqh of Taharah & Salah, Prophets stories, daily manners.
     - Level 2: Fiqh & Seerah (Ages 11–15) - Practical purification, prayer, fasting, comprehensive life of the Prophet ﷺ, Hadith selection.
     - Level 3: Classical Sciences & Aqeedah (Youth & Adults) - Pure Islamic theology, Usul al-Fiqh, Islamic worldview, and contemporary challenges.
5. **Arabic Language & Daily Adhkaar** (`/programs/arabic-adhkaar`):
   - Quranic Arabic comprehension, conversational basics, and daily fortress of the Muslim morning/evening supplications.

## Faculty & Scholarly Standards
- Instructors are certified Huffaz with verified Sanad (chains of narration), scholarly training, and background vetting.
- Dedicated female instructors (Ustadhat) available for female students and young children.
- Monthly parent progress reports and recorded student assessments.
